clips.title: The story
paras: Across the sea, Alliance adventurers reach Ironforge seeking an explosive answer to the Venture Company in Stonetalon. Lomac Gearstrip agrees to brew Nitromirglyceronium if you bring him the needed alchemical reagents.

Gaxim Rustfizzle needs powerful explosives for his most advanced device against the Venture Company. He is stationed high in the craggy passes of the Stonetalon Mountains, far from his eccentric former colleague Lomac Gearstrip in Ironforge. Lomac created Nitromirglyceronium, a compound so unstable and destructive that he finds the thought of anyone using it hilarious, no matter who gets blown apart.

Lomac is eager to see goblin machinery, and perhaps you, blown to pieces, but his Ironforge workshop has run out of Nitromirglyceronium. Before brewing another batch, he asks for Minor Mana Potions and Elixirs of Minor Fortitude. The draughts supply the raw reagents for his mixture, and gathering them lets Lomac judge whether you have even a shred of respect for alchemy.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hahaha... You need Nitromirglyceronium to stop goblins from destroying a forest?!
I don't care if you know Gaxim or not... I'll give you the stuff just to see you or them explode into itty bitty pieces.
There's a problem though: I'm all out.
But I'll tell you what, you bring me the correct potions, and I'll make some up for you right away.
The least you can do is prove you've got some skill as an alchemist before I just give you a sample of my greatest creation.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can't make any Nitromirglyceronium if I don't have the potions... They're vital to its creation.

clips.title: Completion
paras: If I didn't know better, stranger, I'd say you knew somethin' about alchemy. Good, good... The world's not all about swords and sorcery, you know?
